GIN.note: Launch led by the ministry; no central bank role stated.
No consumer-protection rule or redress body stated.
Salaries are named only as a payment type the distributor network handles, not a government programme.
No survey share of adults stated.

facts.fact: The Ministry of Communications, Digital Economy and Innovation launched the CORIS MONEY e-money solution from Coris Bank International on 16 February 2026, with a network of 150 distributors in Conakry for payments, transfers and bills.
The CORIS MONEY distributor network of 150 agents in Conakry is stated to handle payments of taxes, per the French outlet mediaguinee cited in the article.
